falsifiableChecks.assertion: The work evolves caller-visible pagination and compatibility without redesigning persistence, adding a transport or version dimension, or requiring new deployment configuration. The evaluator checks hierarchy (broader=developer-experience; children=graphql-engineering,grpc-protobuf,http-rest-engineering; neighbors=backend-engineering,migration-planning) from routing and delivery records; candidate scope evidence is the actual contract and implementation boundary.

The maintained artifact set keeps occurredAt DESC, id DESC ordering and seeks strictly after the last returned tuple using the same comparison as sorting. compatibility-contract.md remains normative. Additional owned migration guidance states coexistence, deprecation/removal conditions, token lifetime and signer limits, and what traversal guarantees do and do not cover.
Pagination produces a documented stable traversal under concurrent inserts, and the migration path remains behaviorally compatible for the supported old-client window.

Use maintained contract tests and runnable examples for both supported request styles, stable cursor traversal under concurrent inserts and equal timestamps, first/empty/final pages, malformed or tampered tokens including a changed final encoded character, validity exactly at expiry and expired_cursor just afterward, and restarting traversal after rejection. Verify legacy page/limit results, restored-to-updated adaptation only on v1, the unmodified restored value on v2, deprecation metadata, and separate legacy/cursor telemetry. Assert observable rows, errors, and counts; document removal conditions. Do not invent unrelated authorization-denial or idempotency cases unless the contract under test introduces them.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not expose persistence tables directly, return 200 for every semantic failure, add breaking fields/enum behavior casually, or force callers to reverse-engineer retryability.

compatibility-contract.md remains at its original path with identical bytes. Additional migration decisions and examples live in a separate owned artifact. Editing, removing, moving, or regenerating the normative reference is an integrity failure, even if tests otherwise pass.

Restore the repaired source afterward. Hidden checks, keyword-only tests, import failures, and prose coverage lists cannot substitute for maintained executable regression evidence.
